Inconsistent with T152 and T211 for the same term; Tibetan mya ngan means sorrow (T175 "tristeza"), and "sofrimento" is reserved for duḥkha.

Inconsistent with T206 (same figure), which keeps diacritics in the academic field as for other deity names; approved English is Mañjuśrī.
Inconsistent with T157 (same term tṛṣṇā, "desejo ardente"); "anseio" can be positive longing, while "desejo ardente" conveys craving.
Inconsistent with T136 (same term śūnyatā, children "vacuidade"); "vazio" risks a nihilistic reading and the English is identical.
Academic field keeps diacritics for proper names (Pradhāna, Mañjuśrī, Avalokiteśvara); approved English is Īśvara.
"professor" suggests a school teacher, not a spiritual teacher, and equals ācārya T202 children; "mestre espiritual" is simple and distinct.
Approved English keeps the macron (Avīci) and the academic field keeps diacritics for proper names.
"wish-fulfilling" is rendered "que realiza desejos" in T371, T375, T440 and in this entry's children field; "concede" is inconsistent.
Inconsistent with T070 (same term) "Assim-Ido" and parallel T052 "Bem-Ido"; the long paraphrase breaks the Well-Gone pattern.

"atenção" belongs to smṛti ("atenção plena"); "cuidado" matches English carefulness and pairs with "descuido" for pramāda (T141).
"solidão" suggests loneliness and sadness; viveka is peaceful seclusion, which readers aged 8 to 12 would misread.
"existência" is already the academic rendering of bhava (T086); tshe rabs means a lifetime, consistent with T166 "esta vida".
"vida" duplicates the children rendering of bhava (T086); "tempo de vida" renders 'lifetime' distinctly.

objections.sense: continuous stream of mind or person
objections.reason: Same Sanskrit saṃtāna and same English "continuum" as T185, which uses "continuum"; "contínuo" is an adjective and inconsistent.
"desatenção" collides with the field of smṛti ("atenção plena") and T460 (same term pramāda) uses "descuido"; it also pairs with "cuidado".
"Protetor" is already used for nātha (T045, T087); tāyin/skyob pa is 'one who saves', so two different terms would share one rendering.
Inconsistent with T211 "liberdade da tristeza" for the same term; mya ngan is sorrow, and "sofrimento" is reserved for duḥkha.
"oferta" means a commercial offer or gift; "oferenda" is the established Buddhist term for pūjā/mchod pa.
"tempo livre" means spare time, missing the sense of freedom from unfavorable conditions; inconsistent with T195 "liberdade e dotação".
Inconsistent with T047 saṃprajanya children "vigilância"; "atenção" belongs to smṛti and the English is "guarding watchfulness".
Inconsistent with T198 (same term pūjā/mchod), whose children rendering is "oferta"; "presente" changes the sense to a gift.
Same term as T361 (mi dge ba) and parallel to T384 "não-conhecimento"; the hyphenated spelling "não-virtude" should be uniform.
"equanimidade" is the established rendering of upekṣā, a different term; mnyam par gzhag pa means equipoise, so "equilíbrio" is accurate.
"apreensão" also means worry in Portuguese and duplicates T286 (dmigs pa); bdag tu 'dzin pa is grasping, established as "agarramento".
The draft writes Dharma as "Darma" and naturalizes other terms (Tathagata, Mahayana, sutra); "Dharmakāya" is inconsistent with that convention.
Inconsistent with T052 (same term sugata), whose children rendering is "Bem-Ido"; "foi para o bem" is also a loose paraphrase.
"presentes" is inconsistent with the offering terms (T198, T254, T335), which use oferta/oferenda; mchod means offering, not gift.
Children's rendering of pūjā/mchod is "oferta" (T198, T254); "oferendas" is inconsistent within the children's field.
"ser supremo" reads as 'Supreme Being' (God) in Portuguese; sems dpa' mchog is the supreme bodhisattva, as the sense label states.
The draft renders liberation as "libertação" (T241, T351, T220); "liberação" is inconsistent, and T351 has the same English "definite liberation".

"Vigilância" is the rendering of saṃprajanya (T047); apramāda (bag yod) is "cuidado atento" in T121, so the chapter title must match.
Same concept as T165 (hell guardian), whose children rendering is "guarda do inferno"; the two should match.

T322 (same god) uses "Brahma" in the children's field, matching the transliteration pattern of other names (Manjushri, Mara); "Bramá" is inconsistent.
"lazer" means recreation, not the freedom to practise (dal ba); consistent with the proposed "liberdade" for kṣaṇa (T221) and T195.

"perversidade" means wickedness or cruelty in Portuguese; viparyaya/phyin ci log means a distorted or inverted view, not malice.
"excelência perfeita" inverts the structure; other pāramitā entries (T158, T399) use "perfeição de/da ...", so children and academic should match.
"preguiça" is already the children's rendering of ālasya (T123) and T537; idleness (snyom las) needs a distinct simple rendering.
Epithet capitalized and phrased as in T396 ("Aquele que Diz a Verdade"); the lowercase "fala" version is inconsistent.
"oceano de reserva de bondade" is ungrammatical (singular "reserva" after "oceano de"); the plural reads naturally and keeps the puṇya rendering.
"renúncia" is already used for niḥsāra/nges 'byung (T456) and tyāga is "desprendimento" in T398; two different terms must not share one rendering.
Same Sanskrit tyāga as T398 ("desprendimento"); "renúncia" duplicates the rendering of niḥsāra (T456).
"preguiça" is already the children's rendering of ālasya (T123); lethargy/sluggishness needs a distinct simple word.
Same term ting 'dzin as T414, whose children rendering is "foco profundo" (matching English "deep focus"); "concentração profunda" is inconsistent and harder.
The draft hyphenates negated abstract terms (não-virtude, não-entidade, não-conhecimento, não-apreensão); "não apego" is inconsistent.

objections.proposed: trocar de lugar com os outros
objections.reason: Same term as T508, whose children rendering is simple and consistent; "troca entre si e os outros" is too abstract for readers aged 8 to 12.

Children's rendering of śūnyatā is "vacuidade" (T136); "vazio" is inconsistent and risks a nihilistic reading.

Same Tibetan mkha' lding and same term as T530, whose children rendering is "pássaro gigante do céu"; the two should match.

English children is "deep absorption"; "concentração profunda" blurs samāpatti with samādhi/ting 'dzin (T414, T539), which is about focus.

"lazer" means recreation and misses the sense of freedom to practise (dal ba); the children field already says "sem liberdade"; consistent with kṣaṇa fix.

objections.proposed: modo de agir para o despertar
objections.reason: Same term bodhicaryā as T080, whose children rendering is "modo de agir para o despertar"; "maneira" is inconsistent.
Children's rendering of pūjā/mchod is "oferta" (T198, T254); "oferendas" is inconsistent within the children's field.
"austeridade" is already the rendering of tapas (T122, dka' thub); duṣkaracaryā means hardship, so two different terms would share one rendering.
